name: George Sterpu
description: Senior AI engineer with a PhD from Trinity College Dublin and 9+ years in applied machine learning research and industrial R&D. Experience in speech, multimodal learning, and building automation.
intro: I'm George, an AI engineer with a background in speech and multimodal learning. I now work on building automation at Honeywell. I enjoy understanding a problem, working through the constraints, and building something useful.
focus: I'm interested in forward deployed engineering roles where I can work directly with customers and take a problem through to implementation.

experience.description: Graph neural networks for building topology, deployed to a governed endpoint on Azure Databricks. Also working on site onboarding and HVAC fault detection and diagnosis.
Customer requirements, product management, software development, and DevOps for ERP-connected web software.
Developed an end-to-end speech recognition engine for Ergo, running in real time with one-second latency at 100 mW. Also developed speech synthesis engines and explored model compression.
Multimodal learning, audio-visual speech recognition, AV Align, Taris, and open-source research tools.
